messages:
maria (security): Heads up — I'm filing a small docs PR for on-prem preflight checks around KMS/HSM and networking for sealed-site installs. Ran into repeated customer confusion about missing PKCS11 module in airgap bundles and flaky device nodes.
lina (docs): Great. Can you sketch exact checks you want included? I can make a compact 'preflight checklist' callout box.
maria (security): Prefer 4 quick checks: 1) PKCS11 binary present and executable, 2) device node exists with correct group, 3) installer can open module (simple CLI probe), 4) network path (if using HSM over TCP) is reachable on configured port. Keep wording action-oriented.
aaron (eng-platform): For 2) recommend a udev rule example that sets group=redwood-hsm and mode=0660. Also include a systemd one-shot that runs `hsm-check` before the installer main unit. Something like:
```
[Unit]
Wants=hsm-check.service
After=hsm-check.service
```
and the hsm-check.service runs /usr/local/bin/hsm-check.
rachel (devex): I'll add an SDK snippet showing a graceful fallback message: when pkcs11 init fails include the preflight link and a suggestion to run `installer --verify-hsm`. Example in Python/Pseudocode.
sam (eng-ml): Please add the exact exit codes for the probe so our support KB can map quickly. e.g. 10 = missing module, 11 = permission denied, 12 = module load error.
jules (support): Agree. If we standardize exit codes we can script case triage. I can draft the KB replies for each code (two-sentence fixes).
maria (security): Minor policy note: don't encourage running binaries as root on customer-managed boxes. Recommend using capabilities (CAP_SYS_ADMIN not needed), and call out auditd rule snippets if they want to log key operations.
lina (docs): Plan: small preflight section near installer quickstart + one callout box for air-gapped packaging (remind to include pkcs11 .so and udev rules tarball). I'll open PR and drop the code blocks.
rachel (devex): SDK snippet (draft):
```
try:
  pk = Pkcs11(module_path)
  pk.open()
except Pkcs11LoadError:
  raise RuntimeError("HSM init failed: run redwood installer preflight: https://docs.redwood.ai/onprem/preflight-hsm")
```
Keep it short.
aaron (eng-platform): For air-gapped note add a small command to verify inside bundle: `tar -tf airgap-bundle.tar | grep libpkcs11` and show a sample `installer --verify-hsm /opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so` output.
jules (support): I'll paste canned responses into the PR comment once it's up. Also suggest we add a short troubleshooting flowchart image (tiny SVG). If not possible, a bulleted flow will do.
lina (docs): I'll include a 5-line flow: detect -> run hsm-check -> check udev -> verify bundle -> escalate. PR draft link (WIP): https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/7734. Please review inline.
deploy-bot: docs/md-lint: 1 warning (callout-box line length). Run `./tools/lint-md --fix` before merging.
maria (security): I'll review the security wording and the auditd snippets. Please don't land without my sign-off.
all: ack. End.
